scientific_question: Does the accepted co-adapted late c_proj path succeed because it follows the scaled right-orthogonal orbit implemented by Muon-matched Givens, and does that orbit distinguish late layers from the failed early/middle layers strongly enough to inform a compact fixed map?

theory.implemented_family: For a PyTorch linear weight W[out,in], every enabled update is a product of hidden-side Givens rotations followed by scalar weight decay: W_next = s W Q. Output-side rotations, symmetric shears, activation metrics, and global log-volume coordinates are disabled in the accepted configuration.
theory.exact_invariant: A scaled right-orthogonal orbit preserves the normalized output Gram W W^T / ||W||_F^2 and the normalized singular spectrum. Best-orbit endpoint residual is measured with compact output-Gram Bures/Procrustes geometry, without materializing an in_features by in_features matrix.
theory.layer_localization: The same-seed dense parent starts in the same gauge. If its late c_proj phase increments are substantially closer to a scaled right orbit than its early increments, the accepted late-only allocation has a geometric explanation; otherwise task-metric projection or co-adaptation, rather than orbit capacity alone, explains the result.
theory.support_transport: The optimizer refreshes task-selected Givens edges every update. Reusing a fixed compact map requires edge overlap across the 99-update snapshots to exceed both a 10% absolute retention floor and twice the finite edge-universe random-overlap null.
theory.temporal_pca_scope: PCA, chord curvature, and polynomial summaries describe sampled paths only. They are not treated as intrinsic manifold dimension or as evidence that an arbitrary affine chart is trainable.
theory.scope: This analysis performs no fitting, model update, optimizer update, validation selection, or architecture change.

procedural_metrics: best scaled-right-orbit recovery for every consecutive 99-update interval
task-selected Givens edge retention and finite-universe enrichment
fine and phase-sampled temporal PCA descriptions
dense_parent_metrics: best scaled-right-orbit recovery for every registered phase interval and c_proj layer
normalized output-Gram shape drift split into layers 0-7 and 8-11
same-gauge displacement cosine against the co-adapted path

threshold_rationale.procedural_invariant: The implementation algebra predicts exact recovery; 0.995 allows only accumulated FP32 folding error.
threshold_rationale.layer_localization: Require a material five-percentage-point recovery separation and at least 20% lower normalized Gram drift, rather than declaring localization from ordering alone.
threshold_rationale.support_reuse: Require both a nontrivial absolute overlap and a twofold enrichment over the exact finite edge-universe null.
threshold_rationale.path_alignment: A cosine of 0.5 is a descriptive same-gauge strong-alignment marker; it cannot by itself authorize a candidate.

outcomes.right_orbit_and_reusable_support: Authorize only a preregistered fixed-support compression analysis; no training.
outcomes.right_orbit_but_moving_support: Authorize only a phase-atlas compression analysis; no training.
outcomes.no_layer_localization_or_support_transpo: Authorize only functional-metric path analysis to identify what selects useful orbit directions; no training.
outcomes.accepted_path_exceeds_orbit: Reject the stated family description and inspect implementation/state capture before any new model.

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable because this analysis performs zero model or optimizer updates
